# windows_dsc_resource (Resource)

Manages one instance of any Windows DSC resource on a remote host via `Invoke-DscResource` (`Test`/`Set`/`Get`) over SSH and PowerShell.

Every operation first checks the Local Configuration Manager and fails closed with `lcm_conflict` when the node uses Pull refresh mode or reports a busy/pending LCM state. The provider never changes LCM settings.

Convergence is Test-driven: `Set` runs only on drift and a follow-up `Test` verifies it (`not_converged` otherwise). `in_desired_state` reports the last `Test` outcome. Delete applies `destroy_properties` when configured (full replacement, e.g. `Ensure = "Absent"`), and is state-only otherwise.

Import is not supported: a generic gateway cannot reconstruct the original property authorship from live state. Write configuration matching the live state and let the first apply adopt it (no-op when already in the desired state).

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    windows = {
      source  = "kfrlabs/windows"
      version = "~> 0.1"
    }
  }
}

provider "windows" {
  host     = var.windows_host
  username = var.windows_username
  password = var.windows_password
}

# Minimal example: a machine-scope environment variable through the built-in
# Environment DSC resource. The gateway converges with Test/Set/Test and
# removes the variable on destroy via destroy_properties (Ensure = "Absent").
resource "windows_dsc_resource" "example" {
  module_name   = "PSDesiredStateConfiguration"
  resource_name = "Environment"

  properties = {
    Ensure = "Present"
    Name   = "FOO"
    Value  = "bar"
    Target = ["Machine"]
  }

  destroy_properties = {
    Ensure = "Absent"
    Name   = "FOO"
  }
}

# Pinned module version: the exact version is used, otherwise the highest
# installed version is used and reported in resolved_module_version.
resource "windows_dsc_resource" "pinned" {
  module_name    = "PSDesiredStateConfiguration"
  module_version = "1.1"
  resource_name  = "Environment"

  properties = {
    Ensure = "Present"
    Name   = "FOO_PINNED"
    Value  = "bar"
    Target = ["Machine"]
  }

  destroy_properties = {
    Ensure = "Absent"
    Name   = "FOO_PINNED"
  }

  timeouts = {
    create = "30m"
    read   = "10m"
    update = "30m"
    delete = "30m"
  }
}

# PSCredential property: the map key is the DSC property name (here the
# optional Credential of the built-in Script resource). The password travels
# on stdin and never reaches state; bump credential_properties_wo_version to
# rotate. Note: WriteOnly values are unavailable at destroy time, so destroy
# configurations of credential-bearing resources must not require the
# credential.
resource "windows_dsc_resource" "script" {
  module_name   = "PSDesiredStateConfiguration"
  resource_name = "Script"

  properties = {
    GetScript  = "@{ Result = (Get-Content C:\\Windows\\Temp\\tf-dsc-marker.txt) }"
    SetScript  = "Set-Content C:\\Windows\\Temp\\tf-dsc-marker.txt 'managed'"
    TestScript = "Test-Path C:\\Windows\\Temp\\tf-dsc-marker.txt"
  }

  credential_properties_wo = {
    Credential = {
      username = var.script_run_username
      password = var.script_run_password
    }
  }
  credential_properties_wo_version = 1
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `module_name` (String) DSC module name (for example `PSDesiredStateConfiguration`). ForceNew.
- `properties` (Dynamic) Desired DSC resource properties as an object (for example `{ Ensure = "Present", Name = "FOO", Value = "bar" }`). Property names are case-insensitive and validated against the live `Get-DscResource` schema on every operation; values are coerced pure-Go (string/int/bool/list/one-level objects, ValueMap-enforced). PSCredential properties must NOT appear here: pass them through `credential_properties_wo` instead.
- `resource_name` (String) DSC resource name within the module (for example `Environment`). ForceNew.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `credential_properties_wo` (Attributes Map, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) PSCredential property values keyed by DSC property name. Write-only: the map key is the property name and each value carries `username` plus the secret `password`, which travels to the host on stdin and is never persisted in state. Rotation is marked with `credential_properties_wo_version`: changing only the map without bumping the version is a no-op for converge decisions that need no new credential, while DSC `Set` calls always forward the configured values. At destroy time no credential is available (WriteOnly values do not survive to the destroy plan): destroying a credential-bearing resource whose destroy configuration still requires the credential fails closed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--credential_properties_wo))
- `credential_properties_wo_version` (Number) Version counter for `credential_properties_wo` rotation. Conventionally starts at 1. Changing only the credential map without changing this version leaves converge decisions that need no new credential untouched.
- `destroy_properties` (Dynamic) Absent-state properties applied with `Set` on destroy (full replacement, for example `{ Ensure = "Absent", Name = "FOO" }`). When unset, destroy is state-only and makes no remote call. Credential-typed values cannot be supplied at destroy time (see `credential_properties_wo`).
- `module_version` (String) Exact DSC module version to use. When unset, the highest installed version is used and reported in `resolved_module_version`. ForceNew.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `current_state_json` (String) Redacted `Invoke-DscResource -Method Get` output as canonical JSON (credential values dropped, nulls omitted, schema-declared properties only). Informational only: never produces drift.
- `id` (String) Resource identifier: `<module>|<resource>|<sha256 hex of the canonical key-properties JSON>`.
- `in_desired_state` (Boolean) Outcome of the last `Test-DscConfiguration`-equivalent `Invoke-DscResource -Method Test` call: true when the host reports the desired state. Always planned as true so a failed Test produces an update plan that re-converges on apply.
- `reboot_required` (Boolean) Whether the last converge reported RebootRequired. Advisory only: the provider schedules no reboot (warns instead).
- `resolved_module_version` (String) Module version the last operation ran against: the pinned `module_version`, or the highest installed version.

<a id="nestedatt--credential_properties_wo"></a>
### Nested Schema for `credential_properties_wo`

Required:

- `password` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Credential password for this DSC property. Must not contain carriage return or line feed characters.
- `username` (String, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Credential user name for this DSC property. Must not contain carriage return or line feed characters.


<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Read operations occur during any refresh or planning operation when refresh is enabled.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
